newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian PM to make statement on PNG.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian PM to make statement on PNG.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard would make a statement in parliament later on Tuesday regarding the situation in Papua New Guinea (PNG), his office said on Tuesday morning.
A spokesman for Howard said the prime minister was likely to make the statement before parliamentary question time at 0300 GMT (2.00 p.m.).
Foreign Minister Alexander Downer was also expected to make a statement, but no-one from his office was available for confirmation.

PNG Prime Minister Sir Julius Chan early on Tuesday sacked the commander of the defence forces, Brigadier General Jerry Singirok, after he demanded that Chan resign over his decision to hire mercenaries to help end a long uprising on Bougainville island.
Chan said the PNG cabinet had decided late on Monday to sack Singirok and replace him with Colonel Alfred Aikung.
Singirok earlier said Chan's decision to employ foreign mercenaries to help end a long uprising on Bouganville island was wrong and possibly corrupt.
The Australian government has called on the PNG government to resolve the matter peacefully, as soon as possible and in accordance with the constitution.
